nodes.name: _lg_probe.html
nodes.summary: Manual probe page that loads layout_guardrail.js over a synthetic 800px element and logs its measured width, exemption matches, and the direct __layoutGuardrailCheck() result.

nodes.name: hover_layout_guard.html
nodes.summary: Self-verifying headless regression test that runs the real render pipeline (start/polish/typography_fix/helper) and asserts that hovering glossary terms in the drop-cap paragraph causes zero layout movement (rects, line boxes, --cl-dc-* vars, ancestor inline styles).
nodes.languageNotes: Reports its verdict exactly once into <title> (HOVER_LAYOUT_GUARD PASS/FAIL) so the shell runner can grep the dump-dom output; geometry fingerprints are diffed before/during/after each hover cycle.

nodes.name: hover_layout_guard.sh
nodes.summary: Headless Chromium runner for hover_layout_guard.html; dumps the DOM with a virtual-time budget and greps the <title> for the PASS/FAIL verdict, skipping gracefully when chromium or the site is unavailable.

nodes.name: js_validator.py
nodes.summary: Static JS linter for the blog: a hand-rolled tokenizer plus a battery of regex checks (bracket balance, unclosed strings/comments, debugger, duplicate declarations, DOM API typos, implied globals) with rich-formatted error/warning/info severity reporting.
nodes.languageNotes: PEP 723 inline dependencies; self-restarts under `uv run` with UV_EXCLUDE_NEWER pinned; tokenizer is string/template/comment/regex-aware so checkers see only real code.

nodes.name: tokenize_js
nodes.summary: Character-by-character JS tokenizer yielding (type, value, line) for code, strings, template literals, comments, and regex literals; the foundation that keeps every other checker from false-positiving inside literals.

nodes.name: check_bracket_balance
nodes.summary: Stack-based check for mismatched, unexpected, and unclosed (), {}, [] pairs over the code-only output of the tokenizer.

nodes.name: check_common_mistakes
nodes.summary: Pattern table of ~60 common JavaScript typos and case errors (getElementByID, innerHtml, JSON.Stringify, docuemnt, setTimout, …) flagged line by line.

nodes.name: check_implied_globals
nodes.summary: Heuristic that collects declared variables (var/let/const, parameters, destructuring, loops) and known browser/Node globals to detect accidental assignments to undeclared globals.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point: resolves mixed file/folder/glob inputs, runs all checkers with a progress bar, renders per-file issue trees and a summary table, and exits 1 only on critical errors.

nodes.name: keypoint_test.js
nodes.summary: Node smoke test for keypoint.js that builds .md > blockquote trees on a small DOM stub and verifies classifyBlockquote/upgradeBlockquote/upgradeBlockquotes promote short statements and attributed quotes into .kp-block cards while skipping long, complex, formal, or already-tagged ones.
nodes.languageNotes: The DOM stub makes firstChild a read-only getter to mirror real DOM semantics, which keypoint.js relies on.

nodes.name: latex_error_checker.py
nodes.summary: Playwright-based scanner that starts a PHP built-in server, opens every lesson in headless Chromium, and fails on console errors, JS exceptions, network failures, and KaTeX/Temml/MathJax parse errors in the rendered DOM, plus a source-level phase flagging risky LaTeX patterns.
nodes.languageNotes: Auto-installs Playwright Chromium, supports parallel page scanning via a pool of browser contexts, and can save per-page Playwright traces for failed pages.

nodes.name: scan_page_with_browser
nodes.summary: Navigates one page, waits for math rendering to settle, and captures console errors/warnings, uncaught exceptions, failed requests, .katex-error/.temml-error/.mjx-error DOM elements, and regex-detected LaTeX leaks.

nodes.name: scan_html_for_latex_errors
nodes.summary: Runs a set of KaTeX/Temml/MathJax ParseError regexes over fully-rendered HTML and returns deduplicated, entity-decoded issues with approximate line numbers.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI driver: discovers .php/.js files, runs the browser phase (with optional PHP server) and the source phase, prints rich results, and exits 1 on any rendered failure.

nodes.name: lesson_guard.py
nodes.summary: Browser-free static regression guard for the Math IV lesson (math_iv.php + math_iv_affine.js): checks markdown headings sit inside .md divs, citation keys exist in literature.js, auto-rotate is off, 3D canvases are wired to bind3DNav/drawAxes3D, fold matrices stay symbolic, and the quad loop destructures (u, v).
nodes.languageNotes: Each guard encodes a concrete past bug (G1–G7 in the docstring); LESSONS is an extendable (php, js) pair list.

nodes.name: guard_headings_in_md
nodes.summary: Walks the PHP template with a div-open stack to ensure every markdown heading is inside a <div class="…md…"> block, since headings outside one neither render nor appear in the TOC.

nodes.name: guard_citation_keys
nodes.summary: Extracts every \cite/\footcite key used in the lesson and fails for any key not defined in literature.js, preventing broken bibtexify() rendering.

nodes.name: link_checker.py
nodes.summary: Validates every URL in literature.js by fetching it with browser-like HTTP/2 headers; passes on 2xx (plus %PDF magic check for .pdf links), classifies bot protection and SSL quirks as soft passes, and retries transient 5xx/429 once.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-pass regex parser for literature.js entries (order of title:/url: fields doesn't matter); concurrent checking via ThreadPoolExecutor over strict and relaxed httpx clients.

nodes.name: Outcome
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing the result of one URL check: category (ok/soft_pass/fail), HTTP status, server/via headers, cookies, body snippet, and reason, with ok/is_real_fail/is_ssl_error/shorten_reason helpers.

nodes.name: parse_literature_file
nodes.summary: Two-pass line parser that yields (key, title, url) for every entry in literature.js that carries a url: field.

nodes.name: check_url
nodes.summary: Multi-strategy check for a single URL: strict-SSL fetch, SSL-bypass retry on TLS errors, bot-protection detection on 401/403, and one retry after a delay for transient statuses.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point: resolves literature.js, groups entries by URL, checks them concurrently with a progress bar, prints failures/soft-passes/malformed sections plus a summary table, and exits 1 on real failures.

nodes.name: math_alt_test.js
nodes.summary: Node smoke test for the math-alternative-text mechanism in topics.js: with a DOM/cookie mock it verifies applyMathAlts() hides the rendered <math> and shows the .math-alt twin exactly when the math-heavy tone is switched off.
nodes.languageNotes: Mocks document.cookie with a backing map so topics_pref round-trips, and keeps readyState 'loading' so init() side effects don't fire.

nodes.name: php_render_validator.py
nodes.summary: Selenium-based render validator: starts a PHP dev server, opens pages in headless Chrome, and fails on JS console errors (exit 1), unrendered $$ LaTeX (exit 2), or reading-column width overflow via the production layout_guardrail.js (exit 3).
nodes.languageNotes: Auto-restarts itself under `uv run`; --all-lessons discovers lessons by scanning for COURSE_METADATA blocks; check_width drives window.__layoutGuardrailCheck() on demand for deterministic CI.

nodes.name: check_unrendered_latex
nodes.summary: Runs in-page JS that finds $$…$$ blocks containing underscores or backslash commands that are not wrapped in a <div> (where markdown parsers mangle them) and outside math/code exclusions.

nodes.name: check_width
nodes.summary: Polls window.__layoutGuardrailCheck() until the reading column is measurable, then returns whether the page is ok, the allowed pixel width, and the offender list with details.

nodes.name: discover_lessons
nodes.summary: Finds lesson pages by scanning .php files' first 4 KB for a COURSE_METADATA block, distinguishing lessons from non-lesson PHP scripts.

nodes.name: php_validator.py
nodes.summary: Static validator for PHP lesson templates: runs php -l syntax checks, a string/comment-aware HTML tag-balance checker (after stripping PHP blocks, comments, script, and style), and checks for BOM/extra-close-tag/content-after-close issues.
nodes.languageNotes: strip_php_blocks tracks PHP string literals and comments so a ?> inside a string does not end the PHP block early; tag checks are skipped for pure-PHP logic files (functions.php, search*.php).

nodes.name: check_php_syntax
nodes.summary: Runs `php -l` on a file and returns (is_valid, message), handling missing PHP CLI and timeouts.

nodes.name: strip_php_blocks
nodes.summary: Removes <?php … ?> blocks while preserving newlines (for line numbers); string- and comment-aware so ?> inside PHP strings or comments is not treated as a real closing tag.

nodes.name: check_tag_balance
nodes.summary: Stack-based checker that opens/closes tracked HTML tags (void and self-closing elements excluded) over the stripped template, reporting unclosed, misnested, and unexpected closing tags with line numbers.

nodes.name: search_js_test.js
nodes.summary: Node smoke test for search.js internals (exposed via initSearch._internals): verifies detectMode regex/fuzzy/normal classification, smart-quote normalization, splitTerms, highlightText per mode, and extractMatchFromSnippet.

nodes.name: search_test.php
nodes.summary: PHP test suite for search_lib.php that builds temp-dir lesson fixtures and asserts the full search behavior: text normalization (umlauts, Greek, hyphens), regex/fuzzy/normal modes, snippet building, heading-slug URLs, caption ranking, citation author search, exclusions, and index cache invalidation.
nodes.languageNotes: Creates real fixture .php/.js files in sys_get_temp_dir() and cleans them up at the end; includes an mb_strpos end-of-block crash regression check.

nodes.name: topics_test.js
nodes.summary: Node smoke test for topics.js: verifies the TOPICS/CATEGORIES registries, cookie round-trip persistence, isEnabled/anyEnabled/isCatEnabled defaults, the 3-state scoreUnit() logic with reason strings, the layman lens, math-level clamping, CORE_PERSONAS, and the marked extension rendering [[t:topic]] blocks.
nodes.languageNotes: Mocks document.cookie with a backing map (including expiration deletion) and provides a functional marked mock that drives the real registered extension's start/tokenizer/renderer.

nodes.name: typo_checker.py
nodes.summary: Spell-checks prose inside PHP lesson templates: strips PHP/HTML/LaTeX/code, splits camelCase and hyphenated words, filters a whitelist plus a built-in ML/tech domain vocabulary, and reports misspellings with suggestions via pyspellchecker.
nodes.languageNotes: Whitelist lives next to the script (typo_whitelist.txt); a large TECH_DOMAIN_WORDS set (llm, softmax, vaswani, …) supplements the English dictionary to avoid flagging ML terminology.

nodes.name: strip_code_and_markup
nodes.summary: Removes pre/code/script/style blocks, comments, display+inline LaTeX, \cite-style macros, HTML tags, URLs, and markdown syntax so only human-readable prose remains (newlines preserved).

nodes.name: extract_words_with_lines
nodes.summary: Extracts (word, line) pairs from prose, skipping short words, splitting camelCase/PascalCase identifiers into sub-words, and splitting hyphenated and possessive words before checking.

nodes.name: check_file_typos
nodes.summary: Per-file pipeline: strip PHP, strip markup, extract words, drop whitelisted/domain words, run spell.unknown(), and build deduplicated issues with first-seen line, occurrence count, and suggestions.

nodes.name: typo_whitelist.txt
nodes.summary: One-word-per-line whitelist (~550 entries) suppressing typo_checker.py false positives: ML terminology (subword, neocognitron, rlhf), proper names (rumelhart, nietzsches), and informal forms (didn, aren).

nodes.name: typography_fix.html
nodes.summary: Headless regression test that loads production typography_fix.js over a synthetic .md column and asserts all-in-node conversion (both quote pairs, en-dash ranges, ellipsis) while <code> and .no-typo-fix content stay untouched.
nodes.languageNotes: Writes its verdict idempotently to <title> (TYPOGRAPHY_FIX PASS/FAIL) for the shell runner to grep; a 4s timeout guard fails on a stuck PENDING state.

nodes.name: typography_fix.sh
nodes.summary: Headless Chromium runner for typography_fix.html; dumps the DOM and greps the <title> for the PASS/FAIL verdict, skipping when chromium or the site is unreachable.

nodes.name: width_layout_guard.html
nodes.summary: Headless regression test for layout_guardrail.js over a synthetic 600px column: asserts wide normal elements are flagged while the same width inside .cl-block/.optional/.sideimage/.lg-scroll is exempt, and that __layoutGuardrailTag/__layoutGuardrailExclude work as expected.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs in three phases (baseline offenders, tag exemption, fresh-offender exclude) and reports a single idempotent verdict in <title>.

nodes.name: width_layout_guard.sh
nodes.summary: Headless Chromium runner for width_layout_guard.html; dumps the DOM with a virtual-time budget and greps the <title> for the PASS/FAIL verdict.
